placements.why: Nothing in the (currently empty) strata list covers internal operating/HR-process content like onboarding. This envelope's content — a mandatory first-week checklist and its institutional history of displacing a prior practice — is organizational-governance material, not opportunity, strategy, product, or architecture content, so it calls for a foundational Organization strata category with no parent required.

placements.title: onboarding shifts from informal guidance to a fixed, mandatory checklist
placements.frame: What does the current onboarding checklist require of a new hire, and what informal or prior practice did it formally supersede?
placements.why: src-1 asserts a universal, mandatory first-week procedure (accounts, pairing rotation, shadow shift) as settled institutional fact, and src-2 supplies the supersession event that installed it as governing (replacing the old wiki page last quarter). Together these name a durable subject — how the org standardizes and updates its onboarding practice — that future envelopes about onboarding, checklist changes, or process history will keep feeding, not a one-time fact. No existing leaf or strata (both currently empty) plausibly covers this, so it mints fresh under the newly-minted Organization strata.
